method.why_not_ats: No published coach-vs-coach ATS table was found. nflverse games.csv has closing spreads, but this file stores straight-up only so a number is never inferred from SU. Regular season + playoffs; no preseason.
method.universe: Only meetings where both sidelines were 2026 HCs working as head coaches (any franchise). First-year 2026 HCs with zero prior HC games have no pairs.
